name: spellkave_item_detail
label: Spellkave Item Detail
description: Inspect one item selected by its OWN rev+handle from spellkave_inventory (copy both verbatim from that item's own row — not the listing envelope's top-level `rev`). The handle is the item's stable identity: the SAME item keeps the SAME handle across re-reads, for as long as it exists, regardless of tree position or what else in the inventory changed. Returns authorized identity, quantity, containment/equipment role, and owned state in one call; arbitrary item ids are not accepted. Two addressing modes: {handle, rev} copied from the listing (freshness-gated), or target_id — the same typed id spellkave_manipulate takes (entity:156, item:157, actor:7) — which reads the current row and returns its rev.

rev.description: With handle: the item's OWN rev, copied verbatim from its row in spellkave_inventory — not the listing envelope's top-level rev (stable per-item handles, freshness gated per item). Omit when addressing by target_id.

handle.description: Stable inventory item handle, e.g. i:42 — copied from spellkave_inventory. Pass with rev, or pass target_id instead.

target_id.description: Alternative addressing, the same typed id spellkave_manipulate takes (item:157 or entity:157): the current inventory row for that item is read without a rev, and its rev is returned. One of {handle, rev} or target_id.
